description: Header file defining register addresses, macros, and constants for hardware registers in a Linux driver for Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA. Contains register offsets, bit masks, and function-like macros for register access.

methods.name: writel
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: readl
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a memory-mapped register.

methods.name: wrfl
methods.description: Reads RCU_STAT register to ensure previous writes are flushed.

methods.name: wr32_mask
methods.description: Performs a masked write to a register, clearing bits specified by 'clr' and setting bits specified by 'set'.
